entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Roslyn fails to process `[NotNullIfNotNull]` annotation on extension properties #79872
  • Static extension member on a generic type yields an error when used on a type parameter #79871
  • Grammars for all C# versions #79870
  • ServiceHub.RoslynCodeAnalysisService.exe ignores TargetPathWithTargetPlatformMoniker? #79868
    18.0

Closed

  • Quick action to add project reference should add IsAspireProjectResource="false" #79863
  • High memory consumption for mid-sized solution #78868
  • HotReload incorrectly classify compilation error into renaming when changing record class name #79787
    Next
  • C# 14 - Simple Lambda Parameters With Modifiers - Inferred Type Arguments With `out` Parameters #79866
  • Compiler generates seemingly unused class for extensions? #79823
  • `CS0177` is not reported on method with unassigned `out` parameter when calling `extern` local function #79437
    Next
